# Adonias Nigussie

> Growth and performance marketer based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (GMT+3), working remotely with US and EU teams. Specialties: outbound customer acquisition, paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok), SEO and content strategy, and AI-driven marketing workflows. Open to international remote roles and freelance engagements.

Key verified results: grew a multi-product SaaS portfolio to roughly $22K monthly recurring revenue and landed a €10,000 enterprise deal (Pairing.dev, Estonia); a roughly 300% lead-generation lift for Palm Real Estate and a roadside-assistance startup launched from zero (Eagle Eye Business Group); a B2B product scaled from 100 to 500 customers in 12 months (Jaktech); top-3 Google rankings for 14 keywords via vertical SEO for Electric Car Chargers UK (Recognise Design); an automated pipeline sourcing 1,000+ qualified leads a day; ~70% campaign execution time cut via n8n and LLM automation.
